counterexample_or_certificate.property: For all (x0, x1) in [-1, 1]^2, the two-unit additive KAEM energy energy(x0, x1) <= 1.800000011920929.

abstraction_built.principle: Separates a real KAEM knot-to-PWA export from an artifact-only placeholder.

binary_variable_count.principle: Counts one selector per PWA piece, exposing the integer-search growth from Exp 5080.

constraint_count.principle: Reports the generated linear constraint count so solver complexity is visible.

duration_s.principle: Wall-clock duration covers deterministic abstraction and solver work, not LLM inference.

flagged_adversarial.principle: Remains false only when the artifact is honest about solver use, scale, and substrate.

global_error_bound.principle: Declares the propagated output gap after summing the two local KAEM abstractions.

honest_verdict.principle: Terminal verdict says whether this small scale-up was proved or blocked.

inference_substrate.principle: The substrate is the actual local formal solver path and must not imply live LLM execution.

local_error_bound.principle: Declares the per-unit abstraction gap; zero is valid only because KAEM uses linear interpolation.

property_holds.principle: Records the formal conclusion only after the solver returns an optimal certificate.

property_statement.principle: States the exact universally quantified two-input KAEM bound being checked.

property_status.principle: Distinguishes verified, refuted, and blocked states without overclaiming scalability.

pwa_piece_count.principle: Reports total affine pieces across both KAEM variables.

scale_blocker.principle: Names the dependency or complexity condition when the small proof cannot complete.

solve_time_s.principle: Keeps solver runtime visible separately from artifact assembly time.

solver_available.principle: Makes the proof dependency explicit before any property-holds claim is accepted.

methodology_note: Exp 5091 reuses the Exp 5080 exact KAEM knot-to-PWA export for two additive variables, then submits the bound to a deterministic_formal_solver path. local_error_bound and global_error_bound are zero because the KAEM layer itself is linear interpolation, not because an approximation gap was hidden.
property_statement: For all (x0, x1) in [-1, 1]^2, the two-unit additive KAEM energy energy(x0, x1) <= 1.800000011920929.

pwa_abstraction.scale_up_note: two-variable additive KAEM property; Exp 5080 had one variable
